adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6` the `save()` action sends `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')`, but the server (`Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`) overwrites blank `category_id` with `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id`. After the save resolves, the component does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))`—still using the (possibly null) local `categoryId` instead of the server-returned `category_id`, so a host defaulted to Uncategorized can display with no category until a reload/rehydration. Also, since the component uses `bufferedProperty('host')` and never commits/resets the buffer on successful save (only `rollbackBuffer()` on cancel), a server-normalized `host` value (model updated by response) can diverge from `buffered.host`, causing the next edit to show the stale, un-normalized input.
